name: Kurt Griebel
source: From Dresden, Kurt is commander of the 500th Jaeger Corps stationed at Fort Neuenhagen. Despite his high rank being a result of reckless field promotions, everyone at Fort Neuenhagen recognizes the 18 year old as the most capable for command.
